Get New Submissions Since Date.description: Pulls submissions received after a date, e.g. to load survey or monitoring data into DHIS2 or a data warehouse.

Get Submissions By Field Value.description: Filters a form's submissions on one of its question values, e.g. a district.

Get Single Submission.description: Fetches one submission by id, e.g. when a webhook passes a submission id.

List Forms.description: Lists the forms available to the account, with paging.

Get Form Structure.description: Fetches a form's XLSForm structure, e.g. to build a field mapping to another system.

Get Attachment Metadata.description: Reads metadata (file name, type) for a photo or file attached to a submission.

Download Attachment As Base64.description: Downloads a submission's photo or file as base64, e.g. to forward it to a case management system.
